body:
My name is MLMcCameron and i was accused of Hacking on Avicus. I was falsely accused by Grapesmoothie of anti-Kb
which i don't have. I can't prove it because I never though i would get banned like this, but i can say that my computer is one of the slowest you can get running 20 fps lots of lag and bad ping so I can understand why people can think i'm hacking but give me one more chance I'm a good person with bad internet!
